title: A right click on a sound's level line opens the sound's menu
goal: Right-clicking the middle of a sound clip on the timeline, where its volume line runs, opens nothing at all; a right-click a little lower on the same clip opens its menu. A right-click anywhere on a clip should open that clip's menu, the line included.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-12 by the runner on a-range-stays-on-top-when-you-pick-a-clip-and-it. Walk /tmp/rangerepro/line.json: sample recording, soundAddSample (Sample Music on Audio 2, 0-14s, probe window 1728x990), then {"do":"rightClick","at":[935,924],"space":"window"} -> 'right clicking "the picture at (935, 924)" raises no menu: nothing under that point offers one'. y=924 is the level line; {"rightClick","at":[1000,938]} on the same clip opens the 16-row clip menu. {"rightClick","on":"Sample Music clip"} (the clip's middle) also raises no menu. Likely the level-line overlay in ClipPiecesBar takes the hit without a .contextMenu.
acceptance: A right-click with the pointer on a sound clip's level line, between its points, opens the same menu as a right-click elsewhere on the clip
A right-click on a level point still opens that clip's menu (or a point menu, if one exists), never nothing
A walk right-clicks the level line of the sample music by window point and chooses a row from the menu
